about: Every place in the shipped code that can open a network connection, and every fixed public host name. Checked by scripts/egress_check.py (tests/test_egress.py, CI, release gate). A new connection needs an entry here; one that the user did not set up breaks the no-telemetry rule in SECURITY.md.

sites.purpose: requests to the AI service an administrator set up and switched on (cloud only with placeholders; local service stays in the network)
executor connection guard: resolves the controller address entered by the operator to pin the only allowed destinations
presence check: one TCP connect to an already known device in the local network
executor: talks to the app and to the controller entered by the operator (behind the connection guard)
executor: own host name and addresses, to refuse changes to the guest it runs in
executor: finds the own source address towards the app (UDP socket, nothing is sent)
adapters of device families: read half in the app, write half only in the executor; address entered by an administrator
optional NetFlow/IPFIX receiver (off by default): binds a UDP port, sends nothing
one TLS handshake per morning to the addresses of the connections set up, to read certificate expiry
nightly report by e-mail through the mail server an administrator entered
nightly report to the webhook, push topic or chat bot an administrator set up
optional heartbeat: plain GET to the address an administrator entered
web push to the push service of a browser a person subscribed
scanner: single UDP questions (NetBIOS, LLMNR, SNMP) to private addresses
scanner: reads the title of a web page on a local device (private addresses only)
scanner: listens for local multicast announcements
scanner: multicast questions in the local network (link-local groups)
scanner: mDNS/DNS-SD in the local network
reads the IPv6 neighbour table of the host (netlink, nothing leaves the host)
scanner: empty UDP datagram so the kernel learns a neighbour's hardware address
reads the addresses of the host's own interfaces (ioctl, nothing is sent)
scanner: TCP connect to the listed ports of private addresses, no login
scanner: SSDP search in the local network
scanner: one WS-Discovery probe in the local network
read-only hub connection (WebSocket) to the address an administrator entered
read-only switch controller connection to the address an administrator entered
reads TCP byte counters of the host (netlink, nothing leaves the host)
read-only MQTT subscription to the broker an administrator entered
resolves the SNMP device an administrator entered
SNMP Get/GetNext/GetBulk to the device an administrator entered
update check against the public release feed (LANLOOM_UPDATE_CHECK=0 or the setting turns it off)
updater: finds a free loopback port for the trial start (bind only)
updater: reads the health check of the trial and the swapped container on this host
local AI setup: checks the local AI service on this host
local AI setup: checks whether the local AI port on this host answers
updater: local socket of the container runtime (pull the new image, test, swap, roll back)

updater: reads the signature of an update candidate (image index, signature bundle) from the registry of the official image, anonymously and only over https, during an update or rollback an administrator started
container source: GET requests to the container runtime API at the address an administrator entered (socket proxy) or the runtime socket mounted into the host agent
host agent and container source: the local container runtime socket, read with GET only
host agent: the host's system message bus socket, read-only listing of failed services and timers
host agent: local status socket of an overlay VPN daemon on the same host, read with GET only (only when mounted)
host agent: address of an own interface (ioctl on a local socket, nothing is sent)
host agent: pairing and reports to the address of the Lanloom it was started with, nothing else

hosts.purpose: public release feed of the project (update check, optional)
preset address of a cloud AI service, used only after an administrator sets it up and switches it on
preset address of a cloud AI service, used only after an administrator sets it up and switches it on
preset address of a cloud AI service, used only after an administrator sets it up and switches it on
preset address of a cloud AI service, used only after an administrator sets it up and switches it on
preset address of a cloud AI service, used only after an administrator sets it up and switches it on
address of the host from inside a container, tried only to find a local AI service
chat bot API, used only when an administrator sets up the chat bot channel
project address shown as a link and sent as the VAPID contact of web push (no personal data)
licence link of the bundled location database, shown only
attribution link of the bundled location database, shown only (the database ships in the image)
public record of a vulnerability, shown as a link beside a vulnerability hint and opened only when clicked (the feed itself ships in the image)
source of the bundled manufacturer register, shown only (the register ships in the image)
XML namespace of WS-Discovery messages, an identifier that is never fetched
XML/SVG namespace, an identifier that is never fetched
statement type inside an image signature: an identifier that is never fetched
signature predicate type: an identifier that is never fetched
OIDC issuer named in the certificate of the publishing workflow: an identifier that is never fetched
